notes.title: The Breeding Update
notes.content:
🚨 Breeding Update is Here! 🚨
The Breeding Update has arrived, bringing new depth to Tap Derby!🐴✨

🏇 Breeding Updates
• New Breeding Barn – Manage your own sires and dams alongside AI stock!
• Breeding Stats – Preview potential foal abilities before pairing.
• Sell or Retire Breeding Stock – Make tough decisions at the end of the year.
• Pedigree Tracking – View your horse’s lineage and offspring.
• Season Tracking – Watch foals develop in the Breeding Barn.
• Realistic Fertility – Horses can breed until they become infertile (ages 12-20).

🌍 Other Updates
• New Races & Custom Nationalities 🌎🏆
• Replay Tutorials Anytime 📖
• Stable Sorting Preferences Now Saved ✅
• Max 3 Entries per Race 🏁
• Rounded Auction Reserves 💰
• Revamped Sell/Retire Page – More flexibility for managing your stable!
• Sell & Retire Horses at Any Age 🔄

🛠 Bug Fixes
• Couronne Achievement now works! 🏆
• Pasture records are fixed! 🌿
• Custom international race screens corrected! 🌍
• No more training for low-energy horses! ⚡
• Trophy Case fixes & more! 🏅

Get ready to shape the next generation of champions! 🏇💨 Update your game now and start breeding! 🎉

notes.title: The Color Update
notes.content:
Yesterday it was brought to my attention that there weren't a lot of colors showing up in game. A bug was found that had prevented a few different colors from showing in game.
That was fixed and I decided we might as well add some more colors and color probabilities too!

Here is the full list of colors and the probability to see them:

 Bay - 18.4%
 Dark Bay - 18.4%
 Chestnut - 12.3%
 Black - 12.3%
 Gray - 12.3%
 Dark Gray - 12.3%
 Buckskin - 6.1%
 White - 3.7%
 Palomino - 3.7%
 Champagne - 0.6%

notes.title: Custom Schedule Creator
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We're eager to announce a brand new Schedule Creation tool!


This tool allows you to build your own schedule by editing existing stakes races in Tap Derby and creating brand-new ones.

You can check out the tool here: https://tapderby.com/schedule-creator

Schedules created now can be imported upon release.

notes.title: Tap Derby Playtest #2
notes.content:
🎉 Big News! Playtest + Release Date Announcement 🎉
Two big pieces of news today:
1️⃣ A new playtest is live and will be available for around 2 weeks!
2️⃣ Release day is officially set for February 14th!

🐎 New Playtest Features
As part of this new playtest, there are several key changes to watch out for:


 🌍 International racing is here along with 7 new racing festivals!
 🏆 Leaderboards for record race times have been added, allowing you to track just how good your horse's performance was.
 🐴 Training is now more fluid, directly impacting your horse's performance.
 🔨 Auctions are now accessible anytime from the stable screen—no more waiting for the end of the season!
 ✍️ Auction comments have been revised and are much more indicative of a horse's true ability.
 📝 Thousands of new horse names have been added to the game.
 🔧 And many more small quality-of-life improvements!


I hope everyone enjoys the playtest!
👉 Please feel free to share your feedback, suggestions, or achievements in the Discord!
Happy racing! 🐎✨
